headline: A **red wind warning** is in force for the Channel Islands as Storm Austen arrives tonight, with the worst expected early on Friday: severe gale F9 with **gusts to 75 mph, perhaps storm F10 with gusts to 85 mph** ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm62ye5nw5z5o)). Islanders are asked to avoid outdoor activity on Friday morning where possible ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx)).

sections.title: So far
points: This afternoon Jersey's wind is south-west F4–5, backing south strong F6 by dusk, before the storm builds overnight ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/)).

**Guernsey and Alderney airports closed** from this afternoon until noon Friday, with flights expected to resume around 2pm; all remaining inbound Guernsey flights today are cancelled, so inter-island flights are affected ([@GuernseyAirport](https://x.com/GuernseyAirport/status/2113265277316325838), [Bailiwick Express](https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/news-ge/storm-austen-grounds-flights-as-guernsey-airport-closes/)).

**Co-op food and pharmacy stores** in Jersey and Guernsey won't open until 1pm on Friday, so shop today for essentials ([Channel Islands Co-op](https://www.channelislands.coop/your-society/blog-and-news/storm-austen-update/)).

Jersey Met's **red warning** for the Channel Islands was updated at 09:45: severe gale F9 gusting 60 knots, veering W–NW **storm F10 with gusts to 70 knots** later. Disruption and damage to moored boats are expected ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/), [@Jersey_MetCI](https://x.com/Jersey_MetCI/status/2113194399966674952)).

**All Jersey schools and colleges are closed on Friday**, including Highlands College and University College Jersey ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx), [Highlands](https://www.highlands.ac.uk/news/storm-austen-highlands-college-closure)).

sections.title: What's expected
points: Tonight: south F6–7, rising to **gale F8 by midnight with gusts to 65 mph**, then veering west to severe gale F9 by dawn with gusts to 75 mph. Rain turning persistent and heavy, perhaps thundery ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/)).

Friday morning: west to north-west severe gale F9, **gusts to 75 mph, perhaps storm F10 with gusts to 85 mph**. Afternoon: gale F8 easing to F7, gusts to 60 mph later ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/)).
Saturday stays windy, with south-west F6–7 and gusts to 50 mph ([Jersey Met](https://www.gov.je/weather/)).
Expect travel disruption, fallen trees or branches on roads and some localised flooding ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx)).

sections.title: Travel & closures
points: **Flights:** Loganair has cancelled its Southampton–Jersey flight at 18:40 tonight and all its Friday Jersey flights to and from Southampton, Bristol, Exeter and East Midlands ([Loganair](https://www.loganair.co.uk/weather-updates/), [@FlyLoganair](https://x.com/FlyLoganair/status/2113214202286342538)). Check with your airline before travelling ([@VisitJerseyCI](https://x.com/VisitJerseyCI/status/2113248762890215594)).

**Ferries:** DFDS has cancelled Jersey sailings up to and including Friday and is reviewing Saturday and Sunday St Malo sailings ([JEP](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/10/22/winds-ramp-up-as-storm-austen-bears-down-on-the-island/)). Sunday's 06:30 St Malo–Jersey and 08:25 Jersey–St Malo are already cancelled ([Ouest-France, quoting DFDS](https://www.ouest-france.fr/meteo/tempete/tempete-austen-les-traversees-entre-saint-malo-les-iles-anglo-normandes-et-langleterre-annulees-04efa7cc-ce08-11f1-bb5f-3dc5c0feacca)). An extra Jersey–St Malo fast ferry is planned for Monday 26 Oct ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq0k0zkn808lo)).

**Friday closures:** La Collette recycling and green waste site, Howard Davis, Coronation and Sir Winston Churchill parks, and the Jersey and Western libraries (morning). Sports centres stay shut until at least 3pm, and youth clubs are closed tonight ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx)). Jersey Heritage sites are closed on Friday ([@VisitJerseyCI](https://x.com/VisitJerseyCI/status/2113248762890215594)).
Queen's Valley and Val de la Mare reservoirs are closed until further notice ([Jersey Water](https://www.jerseywater.je/reservoirs-to-close-ahead-of-storm-austen/)).
**Power:** no storm power cuts had been reported in the sources checked as of 15:15 Thursday.

sections.title: Official advice
points: Avoid outdoor activity and coastal areas on Friday morning where possible ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx), [@VisitJerseyCI](https://x.com/VisitJerseyCI/status/2113248762890215594)).

Hospital emergency, urgent and maternity services are running as normal. Only call 999 for an ambulance in a life-threatening emergency, and go to ED only for serious illness or injury. Attend Friday outpatient appointments if it's safe to travel unless HCJ contacts you ([gov.je](https://www.gov.je/News/2026/Pages/StormAustenUpdates.aspx)).

Secure garden furniture and bins, and clear leaves from drains ([JEP](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/10/22/winds-ramp-up-as-storm-austen-bears-down-on-the-island/)). Boat owners should check moorings ([JEP](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/10/22/winds-ramp-up-as-storm-austen-bears-down-on-the-island/)).

Don't try to deal with damaged trees yourself; call a professional ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm62ye5nw5z5o)). Take extra care around the coast ([St Helier Lifeboat via today.je](https://bsky.app/profile/today.je/post/3myfq3zlla42m)).
